notes.title: A Small Update for Travelers 🌎
notes.notes: [p][b]Dear players![/b][/p][p align="start"]Our team is continuing the cycle of updates for our games, and the next one in line is the [b]Trip To Europe[/b] series! We've put our hearts into every detail to make your virtual journey across Europe even more exciting and comfortable.[/p][p align="start"][b]Here's what's new in the game:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]A Sea of New Words[/b] – The game now speaks new languages, allowing even more players to enjoy the atmosphere.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Destinations[/b] – Explore 4 brand-new, vibrant corners of Europe, where every step is a new discovery![/p][/*][*][p][b]Fresh Achievements[/b] – Specially for the most attentive travelers, we've prepared a set of new achievements.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Smooth as Silk Gameplay[/b] – We've done a major bug sweep and improved the game's performance across all locations.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Secret Finds[/b] – Something else you're sure to notice during your strolls through European streets![/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]🔍 [b]Dive headfirst into the atmosphere of ancient cities![/b] Take a leisurely walk along the cobblestones of Bruges, admire the grandeur of the Pena Palace in Portugal, and find all the hidden secrets. This is your personal virtual vacation—no packing required![/p][p align="start"]Already available for download – update now and enjoy the new discoveries![/p]

notes.title: 🌎 Around the World 5: Beautiful America Collector's Edition — out today!
notes.notes:
[p]The new chapter of the [i]Around the World[/i] series is here! Embark on an unforgettable journey across the most picturesque corners of the USA — from majestic canyons and national parks to bustling metropolises and cozy coastal towns.[/p][p]This is more than just a hidden object game — it’s a true virtual adventure:
🔎 Over 30 colorful, detailed locations filled with atmosphere.
🧩 Engaging mini-games and logical puzzles.
🎶 Relaxing music and a leisurely pace — play at your own speed.
🎁 Souvenirs and collectibles to preserve your travel memories.[/p][p][b]Collector’s Edition makes the journey even brighter:[/b]
✨ Unique bonus scenes and quests.
✨ Exclusive mini-games for true genre lovers.
✨ Save your favorite landscapes as wallpapers in your personal gallery.[/p][p]Dive into the beauty of America, escape the rush, and enjoy a journey without leaving home!

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3609910/Around_the_World_5_Beautiful_America_Collectors_Edition/?beta=0"][/dynamiclink][/p]
